title: Wheels India, Inox Green up to 5% on QIPs

timeline.title: Wheels India, Inox Green up to 5% on QIPs
timeline.line: Wheels India rose as much as 5.5% to ₹2,300 after launching a ₹250 cr QIP
more: The Wheels India QIP floor price is ₹2,197.10, with up to a 5% discount allowed
Its board was due to meet on Sept 25 to fix the final issue price
Inox Green also rose after launching its own QIP
